name: Muse Code
summary: Run a terminal coding agent on macOS or Linux that spawns sub-agents and picks up where it left off after a crash. Pay-as-you-go at $1.25/$4.25 per million tokens, or over 90% less if you opt into data sharing.

name: Notetaker
summary: Transcribe and summarize any meeting on your Mac without a bot joining the call — it listens to system audio. Pulls names from your calendar and connected apps so jargon and people's names come out spelled right. Free tier included.

name: MiniMax H3
summary: Run a 42.5 GB open-weight video model on your own GPU. It takes text, image, video, and audio in one context and renders 15 seconds of 2K video with stereo sound. Weights on Hugging Face, native ComfyUI support.

name: Qwen3.8-Max
summary: Call a 2.4-trillion-parameter multimodal model that scores near Claude Fable 5 on coding and long-horizon work. Live now through Alibaba Cloud Model Studio and QwenCloud, with open weights promised within a week.

name: Inkling-Small
summary: Download an Apache 2.0 reasoning model that takes text, images, and audio with a 1M-token context, and lands within a point of its 975B sibling at a quarter the size. Weights on Hugging Face.

name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731
summary: Run an open-weight (MIT) coding and agent model for pennies — about $0.14 per million input tokens, $0.28 output. This re-tuned build beats the bigger V4-Pro preview on agentic tasks. Grab the weights on Hugging Face or hit the API.

name: GPT-5.6 price cuts
summary: High-volume jobs on the fastest GPT-5.6 tier just got 80% cheaper — Luna is now $0.20 per million input tokens, $1.20 output. Mid-tier Terra dropped 20% to $2/$12, and premium Sol runs 2.5x faster in the API.

name: Kimi K3 open weights
summary: Download the largest open-weight model yet — 2.8 trillion parameters, a 1M-token context, and native vision, at close to frontier quality. It's a 1.4TB download, so most people will reach it through day-one hosted providers.
